prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production-ready transparent pixel-art enemy arrow sprite for a Chinese Three Kingdoms horseback game. Primary request: one ancient Chinese war arrow flying DOWN toward the camera, viewed from slightly above at a foreshortened three-quarter angle. Exactly one isolated complete arrow, vertical centered composition, arrowhead at BOTTOM pointing straight DOWN, fletching at TOP. Broad dark forged iron triangular bodkin/leaf arrowhead with a bright silver bevel and small warm highlight, readable split pale cream feather fletching with russet binding, straight warm brown bamboo shaft with subtle bands. Crisp hand-painted 16-bit pixel clusters, restrained earthy brown/ivory/steel palette, dark pixel outline, consistent with detailed pixel mounted warriors. Render large enough to retain clear silhouette when scaled to 25x100 pixels in-game. Composition: arrow occupies roughly 75% image height and 16% width, generous transparent margins at every edge, no clipping. Genuine alpha transparent background. No cast shadow, no ground, no text, no labels, no UI, no watermark, no glow, no speed lines or trails (added by engine), no second arrow, no bow, no modern missile. Make the arrowhead more prominent than a thin line, feathers clearly separated from shaft.
notes: 1024x1536 generated RGBA copied unchanged. Arrow points down; iron head, bamboo shaft and pale feathers. Original alpha preserved. Sprite uses AtlasTexture region (370,28,280,1480) and existing 0.75 alpha-cutout shader to suppress soft generated fringe without editing PNG. Engine samples perspective, wake, ghost and air streaks; no generated trail frames or new audio.
